name: Cache support for on-premises data gateway in OneLake shortcuts
description: Shortcut caching can be used to reduce egress costs associated with cross-cloud data access. As files are read through an external shortcut, the files are stored in a cache for the Fabric workspace. Subsequent read requests are served from cache rather than the remote storage provider. With the introduction of cache support for the On-premises-data gateway, you can leverage these capabilities while connecting to on-prem data or data behind a firewall.
